name: Nanase Tsubaki
source:
Classmate and close friend of Sayane, they also attend the same student club. 
Shrine maiden (Miko/shaman) of the Takatsuki shrine.
Her favourite things are 90's shoujo manga and handicraft.

[Edited and translated from the [url=http://www.ray-software.net/tokihako/index.html]official website[/url]]
